summary: Comprehensive final bug-check of Pastasciutta after the latest Report-page rewrite (no-rose-bg, VERS rich-text contentEditable, inline lens, auto-dismiss preview), Federico home cleanup, ChiusureExcel column order, and APScheduler midnight reset. Most flows verified OK. One UX bug found in VERS color application: the first palette swatch applies black (#111827) — see frontend_issues. Backend midnight-simulate endpoint works and archives today→yesterday correctly.

ui_bugs.component: ReportBetaPage – VERS palette colors / COLOR_PALETTE ordering
ui_bugs.issue: Inspecting the VERS palette buttons (5 small circles under the cell) shows the FIRST swatch applies color rgb(17, 24, 39) which is the default black/gray-900 (#111827). The user-requested RED is actually the 2nd swatch (palette index 1). This is fine functionally (5 colors visible: black/red/blue/green/orange) but the request statement assumes palette[0]=RED. After clicking the first swatch on '50', VERS innerHTML becomes `100+50+30` — color is black, not red. The selection-based wrapping itself works correctly and cursor IS placed outside the span (typing '+10' after produced `100+50+30+10` — '+10' is outside the span ✓). RED works when clicking palette button index 1 instead. Recommend either documenting the order or moving RED to index 0 to match user intent.

rca of the issue: Palette color ordering: COLOR_PALETTE array is defined near top of ReportBetaPage.js. The first entry is rendered as the first swatch button. After clicking the first swatch on a selected span, applyVersColor wraps the selection in <span style='color: rgb(17, 24, 39)'>. rgb(17,24,39) = #111827 = Tailwind gray-900. So palette[0].css = '#111827' (or equivalent). User specification expected RED first; either reorder the array (move red to index 0) or document the intent (palette[0] = default/reset color).
